thread:
Rina: dropped a compact prototype for alert list previews + a new 'Snooze' pill state. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-preview-proto :eyes:
Jon: looks promising. two quick things: (1) the preview shows full routing-rule names which confuse PMs; show concrete delivery targets instead. (2) pill copy should say 'Snoozed until 16:20' not just 'Snoozed'.
Priya: +1 on delivery targets. also accessibility: any hover-only preview needs a keyboard-accessible alternative and an aria-live announcement when content loads.
Tess: contrast issue: pill bg on dark theme is too low contrast. bump background or make text pure white. also ensure focus-visible styles are clear.
Rina: noted. design intent: inline list shows metadata only (playbook link, owner, last-run), hover/focus reveals a 180-char excerpt; details rail has full editable playbook. will annotate aria attributes.
Jon: perf note: don't fetch excerpts for every item on render — lazy-load on hover/focus and cache for 10m. avoid flooding the playbook service.
Priya: copy suggestion: swap 'Runbook' -> 'Playbook' to match ops docs. quick action label rename: 'Mute' -> 'Snooze' across menus and toasts. update toast copy to "Alert snoozed until 16:20".
Tess: keyboard flow: make the preview trigger a focusable button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` that toggles a small popover. example: `button[aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="preview-1234"]`.
Rina: will change the preview to a button and add `aria-live="polite"` region announcing "Preview loaded". also adding `aria-label='Snoozed until 2026-03-15 16:20 UTC'` to the pill for screen readers.
Jon: tiny UX: show 'Delivering to: #alerts, PagerDuty' as primary and a smaller "via: <rule-name>" metadata line for debugging. collapsible if long.
Priya: add a what-if toggle for routing simulation — `aria-pressed` state and visible label. useful for ops when they change mapping.
Tess: mobile note: on narrow widths collapse previews into a stacked row and force-popover full-screen. avoid horizontal scroll. also ensure tap targets are 44px min.
Rina: CSS focus example I'll add to figma notes: ```css
.preview-btn:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 2px }
.snooze-pill{ background: #2c3e50; color: #ffffff }
```
Jon: when snooze applied announce with live region: "Alert snoozed until 16:20 UTC" (polite). also include undo action in toast.
Priya: add tiny history row under details: "Snoozed by J. Patel — 3h ago". helps on-call context.
Tess: final a11y guard: any hover-only visual must have focus/keyboard alternative and be described in docs.
Rina: thanks everyone  i'll push updated frames tonight with annotations and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize copy + a11y checklist.
ops-bot: Meeting created: "Design sync  Compact preview & Snooze" 10:30 AM Wed. Recording enabled."
